title: Cheap Retrieval and Observation Credit Assignment from One Quantity: The Value of Information
abstract: arXiv:2610.40030v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory in reinforcement learning raises two problems. Attention finds the relevant item by scoring the whole store, which is costly for robots under latency and energy limits. When a retrieved memory pays off, credit for acquiring it must cross the whole sequence. We argue that both are governed by one quantity, the value of information, and propose to estimate it from archived rollouts with a learned world model. We obtain that, when read at the observation, it yields a provable lower bound on the optimal value of the acquiring action, which floors its TD target and attributes this floor to the observation that earned it. Read at the decision, it defines the optimal retrieval set. A pilot retrieval system, to be trained and improved with this signal, solves a memory task with reduced context.

translated_title: 从单一量实现廉价检索与观测信用分配：信息的价值
translated_abstract: 强化学习中的记忆引发两个问题。注意力机制通过对整个存储打分来找到相关条目，这对受延迟和能量限制的机器人而言代价高昂。当检索到的记忆带来回报时，获取该记忆的信用必须跨越整个序列传播。我们论证这两者都由同一个量支配——信息的价值，并提出利用学习到的世界模型从存档轨迹中估计它。我们发现，当在观测处读取时，它给出获取动作最优值的可证明下界，该下界为其TD目标设定了下限，并将这一下限归因于赢得它的那个观测。当在决策处读取时，它定义了最优检索集合。一个试点检索系统将利用该信号进行训练和改进，在减少上下文的情况下解决了一个记忆任务。
tldr: 该论文提出用单一量——信息的价值——统一解决强化学习中的廉价记忆检索与观测信用分配两大问题，通过学习世界模型从存档轨迹估计该量：在观测处读取时为获取动作提供可证明的值下界从而实现信用分配，在决策处读取时定义最优检索集合从而实现廉价检索。
en_tdlr: This paper uses a single quantity—the value of information—to jointly solve cheap memory retrieval and observation credit assignment in reinforcement learning, estimated from archived rollouts via a learned world model, providing a provable lower bound on the acquiring action's value when read at the observation and defining the optimal retrieval set when read at the decision.
